html:
The Maikulan, or Mayi-Kulan, were an Aboriginal Australian people of the Gulf country of northwest Queensland. They have sometimes been confused with the Maithakari.

Their language, now extinct, was one of the Mayi group. Neighbours included the Walangama, Kurtjar and Kuthant toward the Gulf. The Burke and Wills expedition reached the tidal waters of the Flinders River near here in 1861, and cattle stations and the port of Normanton followed within a few years.
